messages:
ana: small urgent ask for Monday launch + webinar. need a compact verification run: p95/p99 token latency, coldstart heatmap, and a long-context tail probe for quantized-n4.

sam: copy. region and payloads? artifacts?

ana: region us-west-2. payloads: (1) 35-word elevator pitch, (2) ~1600-token contract excerpt + summarize to 120 words, (3) follow-up: 3-bullet plan. traffic: smoke 50 qps for 6m. induce 3 coldstarts.

leo: do you want float16 baseline for delta numbers?

ana: yes — float16 baseline and quantized-n4. separate warmup vs measurement bins. include per-request CSV, heatmap PNG, and 8 samples per prompt. manifest must include model rev and seeds.

maria: add a one-line methodology blurb I can paste into the blog and a CSV header for the deck. tag dataset id.

sam: plan: staging cluster, seeds 9,77,301, warmup 2m, measurement 6m. will capture token-level latencies and GPU util. will push to s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1839998765-quickcheck/. will include reproducible CLI snippet in manifest.

ana: do NOT include KV cache dumps. lightweight traces only.

benchbot: Scheduled bench job rb-1839998765 on staging for 2024-08-05T23:00:00Z. ETA artifacts ~30m after completion.

leo: note: quantized-n4 needs explicit warmup; we'll run warmup 120s and restart workers at minutes 2,4,5 to create coldstarts.

sam: running now.

benchbot: rb-1839998765 COMPLETE. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1839998765-quickcheck/{manifest.txt,latencies.csv,heatmap.png,samples.json}. Summary (measurement): quantized-n4 p95=76ms p99=230ms; float16 p95=68ms p99=185ms. first-token coldstart spike median ~0.86s.

maria: grabbing artifacts and drafting blurb. quick flag: quantized-n4 p99 is +24% vs our last 240s-warmup baseline. will note warmup sensitivity.

sam: quick diff: prior 240s-warmup p99 was 186ms. I suspect staging warmup ordering changed; can rerun with 5m warmup if marketing wants conservative numbers.

ana: hold on rerun unless the delta is >25% vs last public numbers. we'll include a short note in the blog: "numbers measured after 2m warmup; quantized variants can show higher tails under short-warmup conditions."

leo: reproducible snippet for manifest:
bench-run --model redwood/quantized-n4:rev-20240805-ff12 --region us-west-2 --qps 50 --warmup 120 --duration 360 --seeds 9,77,301 --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1839998765-quickcheck/

ana: perfect, thanks all :rocket:
